tokenizer_integrity.details: Tokenizer hash and manifest content hash matched the recorded shard manifest.

evaluation_firewall.details: Training shards were allowed while evaluation shards were blocked.

packing_correctness.details: Packed batches preserved sequence length and mask semantics.

mixture_compliance.details: The mixture plan respected the stage weights and protected floors.

opus_audit_trail.details: OPUS acceptance, rejection, deferral, and override decisions were recorded.

crash_recovery.details: The saved checkpoint resumed the exact next batch without skipping or repeating.

replay.details: Original and replayed batch ids, token spans, and hashes matched.

learning_trace.details: Learning records were linked to the consumed batches and loss traces.

throughput.details: Packing efficiency and useful loss-bearing tokens per second were measured.
